label: An originating cause has an occurring existentially productive exercise
term: productive-exercise reading of an originating cause
definition: OriginHasProductiveExercise F Occurs bearer produces: for every CausesOrigin c x edge, there exists an exercise a with Occurs a, bearer a = c and produces a x. CausesOrigin retains its existing primitive CAUSE_4 meaning of causal responsibility for x coming to be. The new bridge relates that cause to the already defined existential-production framework: an occurring exercise of the very source causes the existence of its target. It is not a definition of every sort of cause, self-cause prohibition, necessary-being explanation or maintenance. Examples under the proposed reading include an existing builder exercising a productive capacity in bringing about a house; a process maintaining a house that already exists does not thereby originate it. Whether a given process truly produces bare existence rather than a transformed state remains open.
note: Analyst bridge, attribution deferred. The untimed CausesOrigin field has no defined temporal or ontic priority law, so a new interpretation premise is required; its applicability to actual origination is OPEN. The source's ordinary-language 'other than itself' phrase in DEF-CAUSE-OF-ORIGIN is not used to prove the conclusion by definition. Aristotle Physics II.3 distinguishes the actual builder building from a merely potential builder: this gives conceptual warrant for an actual productive exercise under a POSITIVE efficient-origin reading, not a universal proof. Hall's dependence/production distinction makes omission-based generic causation a live broader reading; Gott-Li gives solved self-consistent CTC configurations and a distinct conditional baby-universe reidentification scenario (not a solved dynamical self-generation), with the part-to-whole existence transfer still unproved. Aquinas ST I q.45 a.3 warns that creative action need not be a new temporal accident distinct from its bearer. The four existential-priority conditions are separately OPEN, and consistency alone does not establish an actual productive process. Research with primary-text navigation and exact revision tests: docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, Origin-to-exercise warrant reassessment (2026-11-12). The bridge does not say an exercise is produced by its own target.
